summary: First test run for PT-KDRT (Vite/React 19 + Firebase frontend + FastAPI support endpoints). Backend: created pytest suite (10 tests) covering /api/health, /api/auth/client-ip (contract + X-Forwarded-For whitelist match/non-match), /api/scan-product and alias /api/scan-product-image (real generated JPEG marketplace screenshot, data-URL prefix, missing image 400, invalid base64). 10/10 pass serially; AI extraction is accurate (productName='Serum Vitamin C Brightening 20ml', productPrice=54450, platform='TikTok', aiRecommendation='TOP SELLING #1', variantOrSize='Hitam, Size L', earningInfo='Earn Rp5.445'). Frontend: login page renders correctly (MASUK AKUN, email/password, toggle, submit), empty-field validation works, Firebase Auth wiring reaches Firebase (auth/invalid-credential returned). One real UX bug found: after an invalid-credential login the Indonesian error message is never shown because LoginPage is unmounted by the global loading spinner. Authenticated pages not testable (no Firebase credentials). No Firestore writes were performed.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 under concurrency: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0' (1 of 3 concurrent scan calls failed during the parallel xdist run; all passed when run serially). Likely EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget/concurrency throttling — consider surfacing a friendly Indonesian message + retry instead of raw litellm text to the UI.
Invalid/garbage base64 is forwarded to the LLM and returns 500 with a raw provider error; a 400 with a validation message would be better.

ui_bugs.issue: Wrong email/password produces NO visible error. AuthContext.loginWithEmail() calls setLoading(true) -> MainLayout renders the global 'Memuat Sesi PT.KDRT...' spinner -> LoginPage unmounts; on failure it remounts fresh, so setErrorMessage('Email atau kata sandi tidak sesuai.') and the typed email/password are wiped. Verified: error element count 0 and email input empty after failed submit, while console logs FirebaseError auth/invalid-credential.

/assets/logo-pt-kdrt.png fails to decode (img.naturalWidth=0x0), broken-image placeholder inside a 224px box. Known issue (corrupted asset in user ZIP) — user will re-upload; no code fix needed. Optionally add an onError fallback to the existing PtKdrtLogo component (currently imported but unused in LoginPage).

issues: Footer 'PT. KDRT MANAGEMENT / Designed by Ko Kamseng' uses text-[11px] slate-500 on slate-950 — borderline low contrast (below WCAG AA for small text)
Large empty logo frame (broken asset) leaves a big blank block above the card

action_items: HIGH: Make login errors visible — either don't flip the global AuthContext loading flag for interactive email login (use a local submitting flag), or hold the auth error in AuthContext so it survives the LoginPage remount. Also preserve the typed email after a failed attempt.
MEDIUM: Map Firebase auth error codes (auth/invalid-credential, auth/too-many-requests, auth/network-request-failed, auth/user-disabled) to distinct Indonesian messages instead of one generic string.
LOW: Wrap /api/scan-product LLM failures into a friendly Indonesian message (+1 retry) instead of leaking raw litellm/budget text; return 400 for non-decodable base64.
LOW: Remove the unused PtKdrtLogo import in LoginPage or use it as an onError fallback for the broken logo.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/DatabaseSampelPage.tsx is 2252 lines (and AddProductSampleModal.tsx 789) — exceeds the 700-line guideline; split form/table/detail-modal into sub-components.
AuthContext.loginWithEmail() reads profileData/userRole (lines 177-178) and never uses them before calling loadProfile() — dead code and an extra Firestore read per login.

DatabaseSampelPage handleSampleSubmit spreads the whole form state into the Firestore payload, so UI-only flags autoCreateExpense/autoCreateTask are persisted into the samples documents; strip them before write.
Server-side scan endpoint stacks two @api_router.post decorators on one handler — works, but both paths share one OpenAPI operation id; declare the alias explicitly if docs matter.

New 'size' field verified end-to-end in code: types.ts (size?: string), form state + data-testid='sample-size-input', AddProductSampleModal data-testid='add-sample-size-input' with size.trim() in payload, detail modal data-testid='sample-detail-size', and it reaches Firestore via the payload spread in createSample/updateSample. Runtime verification blocked by missing login credentials.

rca_of_the_issue: Invalid-login silent failure: LoginPage keeps errorMessage in local component state, but AuthContext.loginWithEmail sets the provider-wide `loading=true` (AuthContext.tsx:169). App.tsx MainLayout returns the full-screen 'Memuat Sesi PT.KDRT...' loader whenever loading is true (App.tsx:55-65), unmounting LoginPage. When signInWithEmailAndPassword rejects, the finally block sets loading=false and LoginPage remounts with fresh state, discarding both the error message and the typed credentials. Repro: open preview URL, submit any wrong email/password -> spinner flashes, form resets, no error text (console shows FirebaseError auth/invalid-credential). Fix: keep auth errors in AuthContext state, or use a component-local submitting flag for interactive login instead of the global loading flag.
